speaker: richard_field
text: There. Still wet. Read it in the air if you can.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A running title, and a letter turned. The rest is type. I am not pretending I have the page by heart.

speaker: (the pressman)
text: The bar's free when you've done looking. I'll not pull while a man's nose is in the sheet.

speaker: richard_field
text: Leave the bar. Fourteen shillings to you, unbound, and my Holinshed home by Whitsun.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Fourteen shillings. I have them. I promise nothing about Whitsun.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: If both of you have finished discussing paper, one of you may move it. The sheet is dripping on my floor.

speaker: richard_field
text: It drips because it is new. The ring is brown ink. The thumb is mine, not yours.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I see the ring. What becomes of an error once enough copies have escaped.

speaker: richard_field
text: It acquires company.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: He means the wrong letter finds friends. He is not being poetical. Move your sleeve.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not drafting a play out of Caesar. I am reading him where he hangs.

speaker: richard_field
text: Read, then. The next sheet is Theseus. There is an Amazon queen in it, if you are still standing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am standing. A few lines of that will stay with me. I am not starting a play from them.

speaker: (the pressman)
text: Theseus is the wetter edge. Mind the corner.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: Mind the corner, and mind the floor. Fourteen shillings is not a licence to drip.

speaker: richard_field
text: It's market day at home. I never pass a Thursday but I know it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor I. The carrier is at the Bell. I am due there when this is flat enough to carry.

speaker: richard_field
text: Carry it flat. Unbound. The gap on my shelf is still the second volume. I see it every morning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The gap can keep. I have not promised you a day.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: Then do not promise one to fill the silence. Richard, wipe your hands.

speaker: richard_field
text: Fourteen shillings, said and taken. I am checking the register with a bodkin, not your conscience.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: My conscience is for Carter Lane. The sheets come with me, flat.

speaker: (the pressman)
text: Flat, and not on the wet bar. The case is open if you want the sort that turned.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have seen the ring. I do not need the sort in my pocket.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: Good. Pockets drip. The door is behind you when the money is on the bench.

speaker: richard_field
text: On the bench. Whitsun is in the air, and not in a bond. Go, before the Bell thinks you have grown roots.
